svg.title: Sea-King's Blessing — Dominion of the Deep. Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Water classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 8 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Scales of the Deep forks into Grip of the Riptide then Weight of the Trench, or Deepwater Carapace then Hull of the Leviathan. Salt in the Wound forks into Dragged Under then Wrath of the Sea-King. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Water jutsu.

rows, +2 steady-edge route)","tertiary":"Decrease Damage Taken \u2014 Sea King's Armor's self reduction (one row, +10% route)","rationale":"Sea-King's Blessing is a rank-C kit whose five supported rows split 2/2/1: two 38 EP Water hits (Sea King's Armor, Crushing Abyss; 60 AP, cooldown 7), two enemy Increase Damage Taken rows (Abyss 30% on enemies in its circle, all four stat types and no element; Water Dome 35% Water-only on a 40 AP, cooldown-6 cast) and one 30% self Decrease Damage Taken row on Armor. Exposure is primary: one cast amplifies every matching hit the target takes for two rounds, allies' included, and the two rows compound on Water hits, so the route stops at +8% (\u00d71.124 with both windows live, against Blood-Enchanted Eyes' \u00d71.115 exposure maximum). Scales of the Deep answers \"How do I win the exchange myself: hit harder, or take less?\" (Steady edge, Fortress); Salt in the Wound answers \"How do I make them take more from everyone?\" (Exposure). Each Advanced Art carries one tag; the only flat Damage is the steady-edge route's +2 (Grip of the Riptide's +1 commit, Weight of the Trench +1), which takes both hits from Light to Normal (38 \u2192 40). Potency reaches matching supported tags on all Water jutsu (RUL-2026-10-03-005). BUFF","adverse":false,"base":100.0,"gain":0,"final":100.0,"calculation":"static","supported":false,"capped_at_100":false}],"advanced_arts":["Wrath of the Sea-King"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":"Eight nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four, as in the pre-batch tree. The kit has three supported tags on five rows (Damage x2, Increase Damage Taken x2, Decrease Damage Taken x1), one route each: Scales of the Deep forks into Steady edge (Grip of the Riptide \u2192 Weight of the Trench) and Fortress (Deepwater Carapace \u2192 Hull of the Leviathan); Salt in the Wound \u2192 Dragged Under \u2192 Wrath of the Sea-King is the single exposure chain. A fourth route needs a fourth tag (absorb and shield are not potency targets). Universal node accepted: Scales of the Deep is in all 8 legal full builds, so Exposure's fourth purchase is always its +2% Decrease Damage Taken. A 1 BP leaf under Salt in the Wound would end that, but each option fails: Increase Damage Taken twins Dragged Under and hands Exposure's fourth its own tag again (back toward the +10% the route was cut from), Damage puts flat Damage on the exposure capstone's build, and Decrease Damage Taken is an off-axis twin of Scales of the Deep (or dominates or is dominated by it).","design_notes":["Node split: 2 Foundations, 3 Hidden Arts, 3 Advanced Arts. Scales of the Deep (+2% Decrease Damage Taken) is the self-side root: Grip of the Riptide (+1 Damage) \u2192 Weight of the Trench (+1 Damage) and Deepwater Carapace (+3%) \u2192 Hull of the Leviathan (+5% Decrease Damage Taken). Salt in the Wound \u2192 Dragged Under \u2192 Wrath of the Sea-King (+2%/+2%/+4% Increase Damage Taken) is the enemy-side chain. Any two Advanced Arts cost 5 or 6 BP.","2026-10-04 rebalance: the flat-Damage route goes from +5 to +2 Damage (38 \u2192 40, Light \u2192 Normal, instead of 43), the roster default for kits whose only hits are 38 EP Light rows; +3 (38 \u2192 41) was the first-pass value. With no percentage setup it is a steady edge (+1 commit, then +1), not burst. Grip of the Riptide keeps a +1 commit because the kit's only other tags each own a Hidden Art on the same rows: a percentage setup there would twin Dragged Under or Deepwater Carapace. The +1 leaves both hits Light (39) and Weight of the Trench's +1 makes the Normal step. Exposure goes +10% \u2192 +8% (Dragged Under +3% \u2192 +2%, Wrath of the Sea-King +5% \u2192 +4%): two team-wide rows that compound on Water hits sit at the roster's two-row cap (\u00d71.124 with both live, against Blood-Enchanted Eyes' \u00d71.115 and Shakunetsu Sakura's \u00d71.075), and the capstone still pays more than its Hidden Art. The +1 Damage riders on Hull of the Leviathan and Wrath of the Sea-King are removed as filler. Maxima over every legal allocation: +2 Damage, +8% Increase Damage Taken, +10% Decrease Damage Taken.","Wiring kept after review: an offense/defense split (Salt in the Wound parenting Exposure and the steady edge, Scales of the Deep \u2192 Fortress alone) was rejected because Exposure's obvious fourth becomes the steady edge's Hidden Art. With Grip as flat Damage, Exposure gains raw Damage and still out-amplifies the team; with Grip as an exposure setup the pair stacks the route's own tag. Under the self/enemy split, the exposure capstone's only fourth is a +2% Decrease Damage Taken.","Interactions: Armor's DDT row and Abyss's IDT row list all four stat types with no element, so they match effectively every hit; Dome's IDT row lists Water only. Each IDT row multiplies a matching hit by 1 + p/100 and two live rows compound (\u00a73b); the bloodline's Water IDG passive (15 + 0.15/level) multiplies the two Water hits last. Rows are live the two rounds after the cast round, never on their own jutsu's hit.","Delivery: all three jutsu are OTHER_USER at range 4. Armor (60 AP, cooldown 7, SINGLE) hits and gives the caster DDT 30% plus an unsupported 100 shield. Abyss (60 AP, cooldown 7, radius-1 AOE_CIRCLE_SPAWN) hits and exposes enemies in the circle (friendly fire ENEMIES; never the caster). Dome (40 AP, cooldown 6, SINGLE) exposes the target. Aimed at an ally, ENEMIES rows are withheld; SELF rows still land.","Fourth purchases: Steady edge (01,02,03) takes Salt in the Wound (32%/37% exposure) or Deepwater Carapace (Armor 35%); Fortress (01,04,05) takes Salt in the Wound or Grip of the Riptide (39/39 EP); Exposure (01,06,07,08) only Scales of the Deep. Raw EP \u00d7 exposure for the caster's two kit hits, Dome then Abyss then Armor: base \u2248 118, steady edge + Salt \u2248 127 (40 \u00d7 1.37 + 40 \u00d7 1.32 \u00d7 1.37), Exposure \u2248 129 (38 \u00d7 1.43 + 38 \u00d7 1.38 \u00d7 1.43); with Abyss and Dome in one round Abyss's hit is unexposed and base \u2248 105, steady edge + Salt \u2248 112, Exposure \u2248 113. Exposure leads with allies on the marked target and on the caster's non-Water hits in Abyss's window (\u00d71.38 against \u00d71.32); the steady edge's +2 lands on every Water hit, off-kit and outside the windows included. The no-capstone hybrid 01,02,06,07 (39/39 EP, 34%/39%) totals \u2248 127 (Dome first) or \u2248 112 (same round): it trades the steady edge's second Damage point for +2% more exposure, a margin choice rather than a dominant one."],"risks":["Classification: Water is shared with many other bloodlines (expected under RUL-2026-10-03-005). 3 of 5 kit rows carry Water; Armor's DDT and Abyss's IDT rows have no element and sit on Water jutsu, so they need the proposed jutsu-classification resolver. Off-kit Water coverage is unverified.","Exposure is the highest-leverage route: Abyss's 38% reaches effectively every hit any ally lands on each enemy in the circle, and with Dome's 43% Water hits take \u00d71.97 (\u00d71.755 at base): \u00d71.124 from the tree, above Blood-Enchanted Eyes' \u00d71.115 exposure maximum and Shakunetsu Sakura's \u00d71.075. It is level with or slightly ahead of the steady edge on the caster's own rotation and stronger in group fights; no simulation was run.","Off-kit flat Damage: +2 reaches every Water damage row the caster uses. The kit's two rows end at 40, but an off-kit 45 or 50 EP Water row would become 47 or 52 (the Arashima and Blood-Enchanted Eyes precedent levels); that catalog is unverified.","Universal opener (accepted; narrow_kit_exception has the leaf enumeration): an Exposure player always buys Scales of the Deep's +2% Decrease Damage Taken.","DDT breadth: Armor's reduction applies to effectively every non-pierce hit, so +10% makes it 40% for the two rounds after each cast (two in seven); pierce bypasses it. The bloodline's Earth IDT 10% passive stays. Armor's shield and Dome's absorb are unsupported and unchanged.","Damage is formula-calculated (sqrt stat scaling) and then multiplied by the Water IDG passive and any exposure on the target, so +2 raw EP is not linear +2 damage; the rotation figures in the design notes are raw EP \u00d7 exposure only.","Ranked modes: skill-tree effects are skipped in RANKED_PVP and RANKED_SPARRING at the pin, so no node applies there."],"progression":{"currency":"Bloodright Point","abbreviation":"BP","acquired_with":"silver","acquisition_cap":4,"node_cost":1,"silver_price":null,"ownership_gate":"current bloodline","separate_from_normal_skill_points":true},"evaluation_level":25,"game_source_pin":"16498fd776fad9c91e4b84efed4380fe3a487050","snapshot":{"public_kit_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","hidden_kit_snapshot":"2026-09-30"},"audit":{"available_skills":8,"foundation_count":2,"hidden_art_count":3,"advanced_art_count":3,"bloodright_point_cap":4,"cost_per_skill":1,"maximum_advanced_arts":1,"minimum_two_advanced_cost":5,"maximum_parents_per_node":1,"maximum_depth":3,"legal_allocations_by_size":{"0":1,"1":2,"2":4,"3":7,"4":8},"full_budget_allocations":8,"non_dominated_full_allocations":8,"all_nodes_in_non_dominated_builds":true,"nodes_absent_from_non_dominated_builds":[],"maximum_tag_bonuses":{"damage":2,"increasedamagetaken":8,"decreasedamagetaken":10},"supported_rows_in_kit":5,"supported_rows_by_tag":{"damage":2,"decreasedamagetaken":1,"increasedamagetaken":2},"tags_targeted_by_tree":["damage","decreasedamagetaken","increasedamagetaken"],"supported_tags_in_kit_not_targeted":[],"revision":"Fable proposal \u2014 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Water classification / forked tree","source_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","limits":["Proposed element-wide potency classification; not implemented or verified in the live engine (needs a jutsu-classification resolver).","Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Water jutsu. Off-kit jutsu of the element are in scope by rule; their count is unverified. Original combat elements, recipients and stat/general/element filters stay intact.","Bloodline id, equipment, injected-child provenance and jutsu names are not selectors; equipment only gates castability.","Coverage counts below are this kit's rows only. Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.","Damage values are raw power (EP), not final-damage percentages; every other modifier is shown with %. not simulated.","The steady edge is the smallest route on paper (+2 Damage, 40/38 \u2248 \u00d71.05 on a kit hit): its case is uptime, since the +2 lands on every Water hit with no setup. The no-capstone hybrid 01,02,06,07 reaches about the same solo rotation by trading one Damage for +2% exposure.","Grip of the Riptide keeps a +1 Damage commit on a Hidden Art: a percentage setup there would twin Dragged Under or Deepwater Carapace, and the +1 keeps both hits Light (39).","Scales of the Deep stays a universal node: Exposure's fourth purchase is forced to +2% Decrease Damage Taken.","Off-kit Water damage rows reached by +2 are unverified (an off-kit 50 EP Water row would read 52)."]}}

g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Water jutsu. Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Weight of the Trench path + Salt in the Wound
Hull of the Leviathan path + Salt in the Wound
Wrath of the Sea-King path + Scales of the Deep
IDT: Increase Damage Taken · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE SEA-KING'S BLESSING KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
8 legal four-skill allocations · 3 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Water classification / forked tree
